rationale: SA5 is marginal value and subsumption analysis. Because SA5 analyzes redundancy, overlap, and marginal structural contributions across synthesized candidate rules, it can legitimately proceed using SA4's calibrated deterministic evidence boundary without requiring live agent benchmarks.
boundaryCondition: SA5 must consume SA4 evidence under the calibrated boundary (deterministic structural evidence) and must not treat SA4 results as evidence of real-agent runtime superiority.
